previous_experiences: Appointed to data visualization team at H2O.ai in 2016, helping bring AI insights to enterprise customers.
Co-organized the Bay Area d3 User Group and Houston Data Visualization Meetup (2013-2015).
Founded SixThirtyOne, a student newspaper at the University of Tulsa, in 2008.
Built lightpay (★17): atomic swaps for the Lightning Payment Network on GitHub.
Holds a PhD in Data Visualization (Georgia Institute of Technology, ~12 years ago from present).
Engineered broadcasts at Public Radio Tulsa and worked on complex systems integration projects.
Worked as systems analyst at ConocoPhillips, Phillips 66, and Buckeye Partners (2011-2013).
bio_text: Micah Stubbs is a Silicon Valley-based founder and data visualization practitioner with a PhD in Data Visualization and deep roots in the d3.js open source community. He specializes in building visual intuition for machine learning, graph data, and WebXR interfaces, and is currently founding IntentiveAI. His background spans AI tooling (H2O.ai), Lightning Network payments (lightpay), and over 746 public GitHub repos reflecting broad experimentation across JS, Python, and emerging design spaces.
